name: architecture-pattern
description: The architecture-pattern plugin, shipping the pattern skill, as a Claude Code plugin depending on diagram-model and markdown-deck.

plugins.name: architecture-pattern
plugins.description: Author an architecture pattern at any scope as one Markdown document that is also the model and the deck: the draw.io diagram and scenario overlays are generated from its tables and validated against it, and its tagged sections publish as HTML slides and a PDF. Ships the pattern skill.
